profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 64 (NocRoom missing-address campaign): found two conflicting, mutually uncorroborated candidate addresses, a reverse geocode of this rows own coordinates landing in a residential feeling southwest Miami-Dade subdivision and a separate aggregator listing for a downtown Miami facility roughly 20 kilometers away, neither confirmed by this operators own site, and declined to guess which if either applies to this row.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] NocRoom is a Miami, Florida based provider describing colocation, IP transit, network based services, and local IT services (fiber and copper network installation, PBX VOIP, email, IP routing, servers, virtualization) across Los Angeles, Dallas, and Miami on its own site. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This operators own homepage, refetched this session, describes only city level service areas and gives no facility specific street address, and a contact page and an about page both failed to fetch this session due to the sites own robots file returning a server error. Reverse geocoding this rows own independently stored coordinates through a third party geocoding service returned 14201 129th Place Southwest, in a residential feeling southwest Miami-Dade subdivision, as the nearest addressable building to this exact point, which reads as an unlikely data center or colocation location and is not confirmed by this operators own site. Separately, a facility specific aggregator listing named a distinct NocRoom facility in downtown Miami at 36 Northeast 2nd Street, roughly 20 kilometers from this rows own coordinates, describing it as an all fiber network serving downtown Miami colocation, dedicated servers, and hosted PBX. Given these two candidate addresses conflict, the reverse geocoded candidate reads as implausible for this type of facility, and neither is confirmed by this operators own site as tied specifically to this row, this session declines to apply either as this rows confirmed address.
sources_tried: This operators own homepage (fetched), contact and about pages (both blocked by the sites own malfunctioning robots file), a third party reverse geocoding service applied to this rows own stored coordinates, and a facility specific aggregator listing for Miami, all producing conflicting or unconfirmed candidates rather than a single reliable address

reading.body:
NocRoom Miami IT Services has no published power capacity figure. The facility's address cannot be confirmed from the operator's own site, though independent research suggests either a residential southwest Miami-Dade location or a downtown Miami downtown colocation site. Neither candidate location has been verified by NocRoom's published materials.

Florida has four data center facilities with published power capacity totaling 9.35 MW across 13 mapped locations statewide. This facility would rank fifth by capacity if it published a figure, which it does not. The state's AI infrastructure remains minimal by national standards.

Without a confirmed address or published power specification, this campus cannot be assessed as a factor in AI scaling decisions.
